admission.justification: Seat census and archive retry in cli/role_launch_archive.py and blocker gating in worktrees/modules/terminal_group.py ensure no live or owed seat outlives its task folder.

applicability: Leaf and modern series cleanup, abandon, and completed-generation retry while a task folder exists.
conditions: Every recorded seat whose workspace lies in worktree_group is closed and archived (retrying owed targets once) before folder deletion.
Any owed, leftAlone, failed, or unbound-with-receipts outcome blocks folder removal and names the seat.
exclusions: Seats whose workspace lies outside the task folder (such as a master's Manager during series cleanup) do not block folder removal.
Legacy series whose worktree_group equals enclosures/ skip seat archival.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Terminal removal requires seat closure inside the task folder and reports unresolved host archive debt before folder removal.
title: Terminal removal closes in-group seats and blocks on unresolved archive debt
